description: Frontend: complete all missing UI flows and UX improvements. Depends on FEAT-002 (new API endpoints must exist before the frontend calls them). Covers: Edit Member modal and handler, member status toggle button, member history modal, fine payment button + paid badge, return button and renew button in transaction log, overdue detail panel on dashboard, popular books panel on dashboard, outstanding fines summary card, category filter populated from API, transaction search bar with debounce, CSV export for books and members, dark mode toggle with localStorage persistence, custom confirm dialog, loading spinner overlay, empty state illustrations, inline field validation errors.
steps: 1. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Tailwind dark mode config: In the tailwind.config script block, add 'darkMode: "class"' to the config object so dark: variants work via class toggling on <html>.
2. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Body tag: Add 'dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100' to the body class list.
3. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Header nav: In the 'flex items-center space-x-3' div (top-right header actions), add a dark mode toggle button BEFORE the H2 console link: ''

4. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Nav bar Issue Book button: The button currently calls openModal('issueBookModal') but that modal does not exist. Change onclick to 'switchTab("transactions")' so it navigates to the Issue & Return tab instead.

5. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Dashboard secondary stats row: Change the grid div class from 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5' to 'grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5'. Add a third card for Outstanding Fines after the existing two cards: a card styled with amber colors (from-amber-50 border-amber-100), icon fa-receipt in amber-600, title 'Outstanding Fines', value span id='stat-outstanding-fines' defaulting to '₹0.00', subtitle 'Unpaid fine balance'.

6. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Dashboard: After the secondary stats row and before the Active Issues table, add two new panels. First: Overdue Detail collapsible panel — a div with a header row containing 'Overdue Books Detail' h3 and a toggle button (onclick='toggleOverduePanel()') with a chevron icon id='overdueChevron'. The collapsible body div id='overdueDetailContent' starts hidden (class includes 'hidden'). Inside it: a table with thead columns Member Name, Book Title, Issue Date, Due Date, Days Overdue, Est. Fine, Action; tbody id='overdueDetailTable'. Second: Popular Books panel — a div below it, always visible, with h3 'Most Popular Books', subtitle 'Books by issue demand', and a table id='popularBooksTable' with thead columns Rank, Title, Author, Times Issued; tbody to be populated by JS.
7. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Books tab toolbar: Add an Export CSV button next to the 'Add New Book' button: ''. Wrap both buttons in a flex gap-2 div.
8. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Members tab toolbar: Add Export CSV button next to 'Register Member' button same style as above, onclick='exportMembersCSV()'.

9. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Transactions tab: Add a search input above the Transactions History table. Insert before the transactions table card div: '
'

10. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Transactions table: Add an 'Actions' column to the thead after the Status column: '<th class="px-6 py-3.5 text-right">Actions</th>'. Change the empty-state td colspan from 8 to 9.

11. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Edit Member modal: Add a new modal div id='editMemberModal' after the Add Member modal, following the exact HTML structure of editBookModal but using purple color scheme. Fields (all with unique IDs): hidden input id='editMemberId', text id='editMemberName' label='Full Name *' required, text id='editMemberNum' label='Member ID' (readonly, not editable to prevent membership number changes), select id='editMemberType' with options STUDENT/FACULTY, email id='editMemberEmail' label='Email *' required, text id='editMemberPhone' label='Phone', text id='editMemberDept' label='Department'. Form onsubmit='handleEditMemberSubmit(event)'. Submit button text 'Update Member' in purple-600.

12. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Member History modal: Add modal div id='memberHistoryModal'. Max width max-w-3xl for wider content. Header: h3 id='historyMemberName'. Body: a summary section id='historyMemberDetail' (shows member type/dept/email briefly). Below that: h4 'Transaction History'. A table with id='historyTransactionsTable' and thead columns: #ID, Book Title, Issue Date, Due Date, Return Date, Fine, Status. An empty tbody to be filled by JS.

13. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Confirm Dialog modal: Add modal div id='confirmModal'. Contents: icon fa-triangle-exclamation in rose-500 (large), h3 id='confirmTitle', p id='confirmMessage'. Two buttons: Cancel (onclick='closeModal("confirmModal")') and Confirm (id='confirmBtn', onclick='confirmAction()' in rose-600).

14. src/main/resources/static/index.html — Loading spinner overlay: Add a div id='loadingOverlay' class='fixed inset-0 bg-white/70 dark:bg-slate-900/70 backdrop-blur-sm z-[60] hidden items-center justify-center'. Inside: a div with class 'w-12 h-12 rounded-full border-4 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent animate-spin'.

15. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Dark mode: Add function toggleDarkMode(). It toggles class 'dark' on document.documentElement, reads the new state, saves to localStorage('darkMode'), and updates the icon element id='darkModeIcon' between fa-moon (light) and fa-sun (dark). Add function updateDarkModeIcon() that reads document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark') and sets the icon accordingly. In DOMContentLoaded block, add: 'if (localStorage.getItem("darkMode") === "dark") { document.documentElement.classList.add("dark"); } updateDarkModeIcon();'

16. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Loading spinner: Add 'function showSpinner() { const el = document.getElementById("loadingOverlay"); if (el) { el.classList.remove("hidden"); el.classList.add("flex"); } }' and 'function hideSpinner() { const el = document.getElementById("loadingOverlay"); if (el) { el.classList.add("hidden"); el.classList.remove("flex"); } }'. Wrap fetchAllBooks, fetchAllMembers, fetchAllTransactions, handleIssueBookSubmit, handleReturnBookSubmit with showSpinner() before the try block and hideSpinner() in a finally block.

17. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Custom confirm dialog: Add 'let pendingConfirmCallback = null;'. Add 'function showConfirm(title, message, onConfirm) { document.getElementById("confirmTitle").innerText = title; document.getElementById("confirmMessage").innerText = message; pendingConfirmCallback = onConfirm; openModal("confirmModal"); }'. Add 'function confirmAction() { closeModal("confirmModal"); if (pendingConfirmCallback) { pendingConfirmCallback(); } pendingConfirmCallback = null; }'. Replace the browser confirm() call in deleteBook() with: 'showConfirm("Delete Book", "Are you sure you want to delete this book? This cannot be undone.", async () => { /* move the existing fetch DELETE code here */ });' Same replacement in deleteMember().

18. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Empty states: In renderBooksTable(), replace the simple text empty td with: '

No books found

Try adjusting your search or filters.

'. In renderMembersTable() with fa-users icon, colspan 6. In renderTransactionsTable() with fa-list icon, colspan 9.

19. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Inline field validation: Add 'function showFieldError(inputId, message) { const input = document.getElementById(inputId); if (!input) return; let errEl = input.parentElement.querySelector(".field-error"); if (!errEl) { errEl = document.createElement("p"); errEl.className = "field-error text-rose-500 text-xs mt-1"; input.parentElement.appendChild(errEl); } errEl.innerText = message; }'. Add 'function clearFieldErrors(formId) { const form = document.getElementById(formId); if (!form) return; form.querySelectorAll(".field-error").forEach(el => el.remove()); }'. In handleAddBookSubmit and handleEditBookSubmit catch block: if err response had fieldErrors, call showFieldError for each. Parse by re-reading the err object: modify the catch to inspect if err has a fieldErrors property (set by catching JSON and rethrowing with attached fieldErrors). Pattern: in the try block after !res.ok check, do: const errData = await res.json(); const fieldErrors = errData.fieldErrors; const mainMsg = errData.message || 'Failed'; const errObj = new Error(mainMsg); errObj.fieldErrors = fieldErrors; throw errObj; Then in catch: if (err.fieldErrors) { Object.entries(err.fieldErrors).forEach(([field, msg]) => showFieldError('newBook' + field.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + field.slice(1), msg)); } Apply same pattern to handleAddMemberSubmit and handleEditMemberSubmit.

20. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — loadCategories(): Add 'async function loadCategories() { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/books/categories`); if (res.ok) { const cats = await res.json(); const sel = document.getElementById("bookCategoryFilter"); if (!sel) return; sel.innerHTML = "<option value=\"\">All Categories</option>" + cats.map(c => `<option value="${escapeHtml(c)}">${escapeHtml(c)}</option>`).join(""); } } catch (err) { console.error("Failed to load categories", err); } }'. Call loadCategories() inside DOMContentLoaded init alongside fetchAllBooks().

21. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Fix filterBooksByCategory(): Replace the current client-side filter logic with a server call: 'async function filterBooksByCategory() { const cat = document.getElementById("bookCategoryFilter").value; if (!cat) { renderBooksTable(allBooksCache); return; } try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/books/search?query=${encodeURIComponent(cat)}`); if (res.ok) { const results = await res.json(); renderBooksTable(results); } } catch(err) { console.error(err); } }'

22. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Transaction search: Add 'let txSearchTimer; function handleTxSearch() { clearTimeout(txSearchTimer); txSearchTimer = setTimeout(() => { const q = document.getElementById("txSearchInput").value.trim().toLowerCase(); if (!q) { renderTransactionsTable(allTransactionsCache); return; } const filtered = allTransactionsCache.filter(t => (t.book.title && t.book.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) || (t.member.name && t.member.name.toLowerCase().includes(q))); renderTransactionsTable(filtered); }, 250); }'

23. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Edit Member functions: Add 'function openEditMemberModal(member) { document.getElementById("editMemberId").value = member.id; document.getElementById("editMemberName").value = member.name; document.getElementById("editMemberNum").value = member.membershipNumber; document.getElementById("editMemberType").value = member.membershipType; document.getElementById("editMemberEmail").value = member.email; document.getElementById("editMemberPhone").value = member.phone || ""; document.getElementById("editMemberDept").value = member.department || ""; openModal("editMemberModal"); }'. Add 'async function handleEditMemberSubmit(e) { e.preventDefault(); clearFieldErrors("editMemberForm"); const id = document.getElementById("editMemberId").value; const payload = { name: document.getElementById("editMemberName").value.trim(), membershipNumber: document.getElementById("editMemberNum").value.trim(), membershipType: document.getElementById("editMemberType").value, email: document.getElementById("editMemberEmail").value.trim(), phone: document.getElementById("editMemberPhone").value.trim(), department: document.getElementById("editMemberDept").value.trim() }; try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/members/${id}`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) }); if (!res.ok) { const errData = await res.json(); if (errData.fieldErrors) { Object.entries(errData.fieldErrors).forEach(([f, m]) => showFieldError("editMember" + f.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + f.slice(1), m)); } throw new Error(errData.message || "Failed to update member"); } closeModal("editMemberModal"); showToast("Member updated successfully!"); fetchAllMembers(); fetchDashboardStats(); } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, true); } }'

24. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Member status toggle: Add 'async function toggleMemberStatus(id, currentActive) { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/members/${id}/status`, { method: "PUT", headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify({ active: !currentActive }) }); if (!res.ok) { const err = await res.json(); throw new Error(err.message || "Failed to toggle status"); } showToast(!currentActive ? "Member activated" : "Member deactivated"); fetchAllMembers(); fetchDashboardStats(); } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, true); } }'

25. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Member history: Add 'async function openMemberHistory(memberId, memberName) { document.getElementById("historyMemberName").innerText = memberName + " — Transaction History"; const tbody = document.getElementById("historyTransactionsTable"); tbody.innerHTML = "Loading..."; openModal("memberHistoryModal"); try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/transactions/member/${memberId}`); if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Failed to load history"); const list = await res.json(); if (list.length === 0) { tbody.innerHTML = "No transactions found."; return; } const today = new Date(); tbody.innerHTML = list.map(tx => { const isReturned = tx.status === "RETURNED"; const isOverdue = !isReturned && new Date(tx.dueDate) < today; return `#${tx.id}${escapeHtml(tx.book.title)}${tx.issueDate}${tx.dueDate}${tx.returnDate || "--"}₹${Number(tx.fineAmount).toFixed(2)}${isReturned ? "Returned" : isOverdue ? "Overdue" : "Issued"}`; }).join(""); } catch (err) { tbody.innerHTML = `${err.message}`; } }'

26. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Update renderMembersTable(): In the Actions cell, replace the single delete button with three buttons: Edit: 'onclick="openEditMemberModal(' + JSON.stringify(m) + ')"' with fa-pen-to-square icon and class 'text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-blue-600 mr-2'. Toggle Status: 'onclick="toggleMemberStatus(${m.id}, ${m.active})"' showing 'Deactivate' in rose if m.active is true, 'Activate' in emerald if false, with relevant icon (fa-ban / fa-circle-check). History: 'onclick="openMemberHistory(${m.id}, \'' + escapeHtml(m.name) + '\')"' with fa-history icon and class 'text-xs font-medium text-slate-600 hover:text-purple-600 ml-2'. Delete: keep the existing delete button. Also update the member row JSON.stringify call to use a template literal with proper escaping.

27. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Update renderTransactionsTable(): Add a 9th <td> for Actions column. For ISSUED status rows: show a Return button 'onclick="quickReturn(${tx.id})"' (fa-rotate-left, emerald text) and a Renew button 'onclick="renewBook(${tx.id})"' (fa-calendar-plus, blue text). For RETURNED rows where tx.fineAmount > 0 and !tx.finePaid: show Pay Fine button 'onclick="payFine(${tx.id})"' (fa-indian-rupee-sign, amber). For RETURNED rows where tx.fineAmount > 0 and tx.finePaid: show a green 'Paid' badge span. For RETURNED rows with no fine: show '--'. Also update the empty state colspan to 9.

28. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — payFine(): Add 'async function payFine(txId) { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/transactions/${txId}/pay-fine`, { method: "POST" }); if (!res.ok) { const err = await res.json(); throw new Error(err.message || "Failed to pay fine"); } showToast("Fine marked as paid!"); fetchAllTransactions(); fetchDashboardStats(); } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, true); } }'

29. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — renewBook(): Add 'async function renewBook(txId) { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/transactions/${txId}/renew?days=7`, { method: "PUT" }); if (!res.ok) { const err = await res.json(); throw new Error(err.message || "Failed to renew"); } const tx = await res.json(); showToast("Loan renewed! New due date: " + tx.dueDate); fetchAllTransactions(); populateReturnDropdown(); } catch (err) { showToast(err.message, true); } }'

30. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — quickReturn() fix: Convert to async and ensure populateReturnDropdown() is awaited before setting the select value: 'async function quickReturn(transactionId) { switchTab("transactions"); await populateReturnDropdown(); const select = document.getElementById("returnTransactionSelect"); if (select) { select.value = transactionId; previewReturnFine(); select.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" }); } }'

31. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Overdue detail panel: Add 'let overdueDetailLoaded = false; function toggleOverduePanel() { const content = document.getElementById("overdueDetailContent"); const chevron = document.getElementById("overdueChevron"); if (content.classList.contains("hidden")) { content.classList.remove("hidden"); chevron.classList.add("rotate-180"); if (!overdueDetailLoaded) { loadOverdueDetail(); overdueDetailLoaded = true; } } else { content.classList.add("hidden"); chevron.classList.remove("rotate-180"); } }'. Add 'async function loadOverdueDetail() { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/transactions/overdue`); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(); const list = await res.json(); const tbody = document.getElementById("overdueDetailTable"); const today = new Date(); if (!list.length) { tbody.innerHTML = "No overdue books."; return; } tbody.innerHTML = list.map(tx => { const daysOverdue = Math.floor((today - new Date(tx.dueDate)) / 86400000); const estFine = daysOverdue * 5; return `${escapeHtml(tx.member.name)}${escapeHtml(tx.book.title)}${tx.issueDate}${tx.dueDate}${daysOverdue} day(s)₹${estFine.toFixed(2)}`; }).join(""); } catch { document.getElementById("overdueDetailTable").innerHTML = "Failed to load overdue data."; } }'

32. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Popular books panel: Add 'async function loadPopularBooks() { try { const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/books/popular`); if (!res.ok) return; const books = await res.json(); const tbody = document.getElementById("popularBooksTable"); if (!tbody) return; if (!books.length) { tbody.innerHTML = "No data yet."; return; } tbody.innerHTML = books.map((b, i) => `#${i+1}${escapeHtml(b.title)}${escapeHtml(b.author)}${b.issueCount}`).join(""); } catch (err) { console.error("Failed to load popular books", err); } }'. Call loadPopularBooks() at the end of the fetchDashboardStats() success block.

33. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — Outstanding fines summary: Add 'function updateOutstandingFines() { const total = allTransactionsCache.filter(t => !t.finePaid && t.fineAmount > 0).reduce((sum, t) => sum + (t.fineAmount || 0), 0); const el = document.getElementById("stat-outstanding-fines"); if (el) el.innerText = "₹" + total.toFixed(2); }'. Call updateOutstandingFines() at the end of fetchAllTransactions() success block and after payFine() success.

34. src/main/resources/static/js/app.js — CSV export: Add 'function exportTableToCSV(data, filename, columns) { const header = columns.map(c => c.header).join(","); const rows = data.map(row => columns.map(c => { const val = typeof c.key === "function" ? c.key(row) : (row[c.key] ?? ""); return "\"" + String(val).replace(/"/g, "\'\'") + "\""; }).join(",")); const csv = [header, ...rows].join("\n"); const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" }); const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a = document.createElement("a"); a.href = url; a.download = filename; a.click(); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }'. Add 'function exportBooksCSV() { exportTableToCSV(allBooksCache, "books.csv", [{header:"ID",key:"id"},{header:"Title",key:"title"},{header:"Author",key:"author"},{header:"ISBN",key:"isbn"},{header:"Category",key:"category"},{header:"Total Copies",key:"totalCopies"},{header:"Available",key:"availableCopies"},{header:"Issue Count",key:"issueCount"}]); }'. Add 'function exportMembersCSV() { exportTableToCSV(allMembersCache, "members.csv", [{header:"ID",key:"id"},{header:"Name",key:"name"},{header:"Membership Number",key:"membershipNumber"},{header:"Type",key:"membershipType"},{header:"Department",key:"department"},{header:"Email",key:"email"},{header:"Phone",key:"phone"},{header:"Status",key: m => m.active ? "Active" : "Inactive"}]); }'
